data.purpose: Owns construction and lowering systems: CFG contracts, edges, loops, calls, stack shapes; construction layouts, placement, and verified instruction-fragment generators; unsafe raw construction, import, stepping, and emission; implements the normative authored assembly construction surface.

data.note: User-assigned g-construct ownership. Implements construction and lowering while docs/ASSEMBLY_CONSTRUCTION.md remains normatively owned by g-design.

risks: Foundation, memory, and ISA interfaces are evolving in parallel; milestones must depend only on merged contracts.
The authored surface must not leak unsafe constructors or require spike-local structural proofs.
Shared normative edits require coordination with g-design.

steps.text: Write docs/CONSTRUCTION_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md from the normative assembly and instruction contracts.
Inventory existing and demanded CFG/Construct/Unsafe APIs and map their dependencies.
Implement typed block, edge, loop, call, and stack-shape contracts with focused tests.
Implement layouts, placement, and verified instruction-fragment generators.
Implement the narrow raw construction, import, stepping, and emission boundary.
Wire aggregate imports and CI, run trust/build gates, and nominate independent review.

data.summary: Establish the implementation plan, inventory the demanded API, and land dependency-safe vertical slices from authored CFG through verified fragments to unsafe emission.
